value: Darion claims the last of the work. At the runeforge, he joins the unholy, blood and frost powers, the gathered souls and the throne fragments to the waiting edge. Blue fire rises around the anvil. The axe passes into Darion's hands, then to its wielder. He sends it forth against the Lich King: Shadowmourne is no longer a rumor among smiths, but a weapon carried by the living.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
